description: This is a unit test class for the RetrievePolicyIdStrategy, testing its behavior in retrieving and handling policy IDs within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyIdStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test for RetrievePolicyIdStrategy class, verifying immutability and policy ID retrieval logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of RetrievePolicyIdStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that RetrievePolicyIdStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: retrieveExistingPolicyId
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of an existing policy ID and checks the correctness of the response.

methods.name: retrieveNonExistingPolicyId
methods.description: Tests handling of cases where the policy ID does not exist, expecting an exception.
